note: Traffic congestion data is manually curated based on typical patterns observed on major Kenyan highways and urban corridors. For real-time conditions, users are directed to Google Maps' live traffic layer. Sources include: NTSA Traffic Monitoring Reports (2024–2025), KNBS Economic Survey — Transport & Communication, Kenya Police Traffic Department observations, The Standard / Daily Nation / The Star / Citizen TV traffic updates, and direct community reports via SafeSteps. This data should not be treated as official or real-time — always check live conditions before relying on it for time-sensitive routing. Additional verified traffic sources: Citizen Digital, K24 Plus, Radio Citizen, NTV.
